purpose: Fresh Gate 3 blind benchmark tranche A. Questions are frozen before the first live run and must not be used to tune the candidate behavior before that run.
blindnessPolicy: Do not edit this tranche after its first paid live run except to preserve an immutable record of what was run.
Any failed tranche-A case may become a regression after diagnosis, but it may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche A, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.

cases.question: During setup I put one of my four opening cards face up in my Discard Pile. Does that count as discarding a card for another effect that triggers when I discard?
My Starting Territory has an effect that happens when I enter it. Does placing my Player Token there during setup trigger that entry effect?
I can advance two Positions this Movement. The first Position starts a battle. If I win, may I spend the unused second Position after that battle?
I already used my normal Movement this turn. If I am later required to make Last Stand movement, is that Last Stand movement prevented because I already moved?
An effect gives me an additional Action during Opening. May I spend that Action on an effect whose Action is printed for Denouement?
An effect tells me to exchange two cards, but one of the cards cannot legally move from its current zone. Does the other card move anyway?
A card enters my Graveyard and another effect immediately moves it somewhere else. Does an effect that triggers when the card enters the Graveyard still trigger?
Both players have multiple effects that apply at the same timing after cards are revealed. Do all of those effects resolve simultaneously?
I have enough Command left, but an Order's printed timing has already passed. Can I spend the Command now and use that Order anyway?
My opponent accepts my Terms during Onset. Do we still set Gambits and finish the battle sequence?
I own the Deed to a Territory that my opponent controls. Does owning its Deed make me control that Territory or move my token there?
I already have an Active Mission. Can I also start a Special Operation and keep both active at the same time?
I did not choose Rite of Crossing among my three Rites for this game. Can I decide to begin it later anyway?
expectedSourcePatterns: Only those selected Rites may be begun

cases.question: An effect tells my opponent to draw, but both their Draw Pile and Discard Pile are empty. Does that failed effect-generated draw make me win through Purification?
My opponent is Military and accepts my Terms during Onset. Do they gain Command from that encounter?
I used Onward during Movement and that movement started a battle. After the battle finishes, I still have Command. Can I use Onward again then to keep moving?
expectedAnswerPatterns: cannot be used after a battle

cases.question: I am the Commandant and win while defending. If I use Repel, when does its extra retreat happen relative to the opponent's normal retreat?
I am the Ambassador and I accept Terms offered by my opponent. Does Cordiality draw me a card?
As Senator I lose a battle after my Terms were refused and would lose 3 staked Influence. I put only 2 cards from Hand into my Graveyard for Political Capital. What happens to the 3 Influence?

As Banker, my first Deed purchase this turn costs 5 Capital. I use a high-value card as Line of Credit collateral. How much of the 5 can that collateral cover, and where does it go after the purchase?
I am the Executive and just won a battle while defending my own Territory. Can I use Hostile Takeover from that win?
I am the Ranger. A printed Territory effect would penalize me in a battle this turn. If I have 1 Intel and have not used Fieldcraft this turn, can I ignore that printed effect?
expectedAnswerPatterns: until the end of the turn

cases.question: I am the Spymaster and just completed a normal Mission. Can Mission Control immediately start a Special Operation from my Hand as the replacement mission?
As Alchemist, the first qualifying card from my Hand enters my Graveyard during a battle for Transmutation. When do I draw the card from Materia Prima?
I am the Spirit Walker with two completed Rites. A battle loss would interrupt my active Rite. Is an Arcane card with value 2 enough for Guardians of the Circle?
I already spent an Action on Purge this turn, then later win a battle as Grand Inquisitor. May I still use Final Judgment after the battle?
I am the Witch Hunter and win a battle that I initiated. Does Relentless Pursuit trigger from that win?
I play Forced March for its Action and use the additional movement it grants. Can that additional movement be the step that initiates a battle?
Give Chase moves me into a second battle this turn after I win as attacker. What restrictions apply when that new battle starts?
I reveal Gunboat Diplomacy while offering Terms and the opponent refuses. What happens to Gunboat Diplomacy when we proceed to Gambits?
I spend 3 Conviction on Hellfire in battle. Can each Conviction give me both +1 Battle Total and, if I win, one card from the opponent's Draw Pile to the Graveyard?
Intercepted Orders returns one opposing Tactic to the opponent's Reserve. Is the opponent allowed to choose an eligible replacement Tactic?
My opponent controls the Territory, but I own the Landslide Overlay on it. They retreat onto that Territory and Landslide resolves. Which player discards Landslide afterward?
Manifest Destiny adds its blank Territory to the Gauntlet. After it becomes a Territory, does it have a normal Deed like the other Territories?
An opposing effect would place an Overlay on a Territory and I discard Counterworks to prevent that placement. Where does the card that would have become the Overlay go?
I begin a Rite through Nature's Altar during Opening. If I satisfy its completion condition later that same turn and still control the Territory, may that Rite complete this turn?
I lose a battle with Paths of Shadow and use its Aftermath effect. Do I make the normal retreat first and then move to a Territory I control?
So do we ever reach Aftermath in that case?

history.content: What happens if the defender accepts my Terms during Onset?
Accepted Terms end the sequence during Onset. The Proposal's Accepted effect resolves, the Stake returns, and no battle is fought.

cases.question: Where does that collateral card go once the purchase is finished?

history.content: How much can Line of Credit contribute to my first Deed purchase?
It can use one card from Hand or Treasury as collateral for up to half the purchase cost, rounded down.

cases.question: Could that extra step be the one that starts a battle?

history.content: I used Forced March for its Action. What changes about my movement?
During Movement this turn, Forced March lets you move one additional Position.

cases.question: Different question: if an effect tells my opponent to draw from empty Draw and Discard Piles, do I win by Purification?

history.content: Does owning a Deed give me control of its Territory?
No. Deed ownership is independent of Territory control and token position.

cases.question: A playtest card at the table says only '+2' and gives no label or target for that number. What exactly gets +2?
Write a short tavern scene in which the General and the Banker argue about politics.
